newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen shares close up slightly in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares close up slightly in slow trade.

text.p: Shenzhen's A and B share indices closed slightly higher on Thursday in dull trading with most institutions staying on the sidelines, brokers said.
The B share index inched up 0.47 points or 0.33 percent to end at 140.74 on thin volume of 13.57 million shares worth HK$67.41 million versus Wednesday's HK$96.51 million.
The A share index added 3.89 points or 1.18 percent to close at 333.63 on turnover of 2.94 billion yuan compared with 3.43 billion yuan the previous session.
Most institutions were unwilling to engage in large-scale trading in the absence of market-moving news, brokers said.
The market is likely to continue to move in a narrow range over the next few sessions, one analyst said.
"Counters likely to post healthy 1996 results will become relatively strong performers in the run-up to the corporate annual report season," a broker at China Guotai Securities said.
Dadonghai, the best B share performer, rose HK$0.11 or 3.15 percent to HK$3.60 on the day's heaviest trade of 2.90 million shares on institutional buying, brokers said.

The hotelier said on Thursday it is set to launch an offer of 11 million A shares priced at 3.20 yuan each on January 13 and forecast net profits of 66.12 million yuan for 1997 versus an estimated 57.20 million yuan for 1996.
Television tube maker SEG, the second most active counter, advanced HK$0.08 to HK$6.26 on volume of 2.36 million shares due to investor optimism over its 1996 results, brokers said.
Shenzhen Properties put in the weakest performance, sliding HK$0.11 or 2.86 percent to HK$3.73 with only 94,401 shares were traded.
Changan Automobile edged down HK$0.02 to HK$4.48 on trade of one million shares on a correction, brokers said.
On the A share market, property concern Shenzhen Fountain was the biggest gainer, surging 0.91 yuan to its 10 percent limit-up of 9.96 yuan on speculative buying, brokers said.
Automobile parts maker Chengdu Engine Fittings climbed 0.36 yuan or 6.50 percent to 5.90 yuan on speculative demand by institutions.
